domain: four Boolean legs; all scalar entries rational

definitions.H: H a b = if a && b then (-1:Rat) else 1
definitions.COPY4: one exactly on the constant-false and constant-true Boolean assignments, zero otherwise
definitions.EVEN4: zero on odd parity, one on even parity
definitions.tensorCopy4: sum x:Fin4->Bool ((product i:Fin4 H(y i)(x i)) * COPY4 x)
definitions.gaussian4: Six independent rational upper entries; empty subset 1, two-bit subsets the corresponding aij, full subset a01*a23-a02*a13+a03*a12, odd subsets 0
definitions.hMatrix: Matrix Bool Bool Rat with entries H
definitions.hInverse: Matrix Bool Bool Rat with entries H/2

obligations.tensor_copy_even: forall y:Fin4->Bool, tensorCopy4 y = 2 * EVEN4 y
obligations.gaussian_ones_even: forall y:Fin4->Bool, gaussian4 1 1 1 1 1 1 y = EVEN4 y
obligations.hadamard_inverse: hInverse * hMatrix = 1 and hMatrix * hInverse = 1, with actual Matrix multiplication over Rat
